pages: Day 115: The first village. He did not let us in through the gate. We waited in the treeline until the lamps went out, and then His men went ahead. I had only ever seen Him heal. I had never seen Him point.

The golems fell first. He walked up to them and laid a hand on their chests and they knelt and did not get up. I do not know what He said to them. The villagers came out to see, and that was what He had waited for.

By dawn it was done. He walked the street once, from the well to the bell, and counted. Thirty-one, He said. Thirty-one less. Then He had the doors nailed shut, the wells drained and the fields turned over, so nothing would grow here that could carry it further.
